claims.text: Postpartum hemorrhage is blood loss > 1000 mL, or blood loss with signs of hypovolemia, within 24 hours of birth; the diagnosis is clinical.
claims.quote: Postpartum hemorrhage is blood loss of > 1000 mL or blood loss accompanied by symptoms or signs of hypovolemia within 24 hours after childbirth. Diagnosis is clinical.

claims.text: Assess: a clinical estimate of blood loss and vital-sign monitoring.
claims.quote: Diagnosis of Postpartum Hemorrhage Clinical estimate of blood loss Monitoring vital signs

claims.text: Look for the source: explore the uterus for lacerations and retained placenta, and examine the cervix and vagina.
claims.quote: In addition, the uterus is explored for lacerations and retained placental tissues. The cervix and vagina are also examined; lacerations are repaired.

claims.text: Check the placenta for completeness after delivery; if it is incomplete, explore the uterus and remove retained fragments.
claims.quote: After the placenta is delivered, it is thoroughly examined for completeness; if it is incomplete, the uterus is manually explored and retained fragments are removed.
